text_block_list.text:
One day off. A crowd had somehow gathered 
at the shrine. Curious, I walked over to 
take a look...

text_block_list.name: Tokujiro
text_block_list.text:
Hm! A cry for help? I shall be there at 
once!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: All right, cuuuut!!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, Tokujiro-san in the flesh...! That 
beautiful nanba running stride... To think 
I'd get to see it right in front of my own 
eyes...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Heavy, low, and profound!! In that voice 
of commanding presence, one can feel the 
vast years of craft! It resounds deep in 
the core of my body just like a Verdi 
opera!
choice_data_list: Were you watching a period drama shoot?
Were you watching a period drama shoot?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's "Helping Samurai: Tokujiro-san". 
It's a drama that's been airing for a very 
long time, you see. When I heard they were 
filming here, I was looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Period dramas, much like opera, are a 
traditional culture beloved by the masses 
across generations! To appreciate it live 
in person—what splendid fortune!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Right after that line comes the duel 
scene with the villain, you know. The 
swordplay is so flashy and just simply—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? Oh my, oh my? Look, look, that 
samurai sitting over there! It's that 
person from a while back!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
He's the samurai who only appeared once, 
three seasons ago! My, I wonder if he's 
making another appearance. How exciting!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Because when he appeared before, he was 
staring intently at Tokujiro-san from 
behind the shadow of a pine tree, you see. 
I've been wondering about their 
relationship ever since...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You spread the wings of imagination, 
seeking to reach the thoughts of the 
creator! Will the answer be unveiled upon 
the dueling grounds, I wonder?!

The shoot moved its location into the 
forest. There, an intense swordfight 
between Tokujiro and the samurai unfolded.

text_block_list.name: Tokujiro
text_block_list.text:
Further evil deeds will only bring about 
your own ruin... Before that comes to 
pass, allow me to awaken your senses!

text_block_list.name: Tokujiro
text_block_list.text: Forgive me!

text_block_list.name: Tokujiro
text_block_list.text:
Helping and being helped, the journey 
called life goes on... Lest you meet your 
end halfway along the path, accumulate 
virtue.

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: All right, cuuuut!!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Th-This is...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
A new chapter! A new chapter is 
beginning~!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
The catchphrase! It became new, didn't it! 
A new catchphrase is the sign of a new 
chapter starting!
choice_data_list: What was the previous one like?
What was the previous one like?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Acute-san. Since we're here, why not give 
a demonstration? I shall play the 
counterpart! A duet!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ohh~, that sounds wonderful~! Then please 
lend me a hand~! Let's start from where 
Tokujiro-san strikes down his foe~!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: —Forgive me!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Guh...!! Is this the ordeal bestowed upon 
me...? However...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Forgive me!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Aahh...! I cannot give up...! Like Tamino 
and Papageno who rise for love, again and 
again...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Forgive, forgive, forgive meee!!!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Helping and being helped, the world turns 
round... Turn over a new leaf, and 
accumulate virtue.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...And so, the previous catchphrase went 
something like that. Ah, he didn't strike 
multiple times, though. "The world turns 
round" changed into talking about life, 
didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Even so, to think that samurai would 
appear again. And right in time for the 
new chapter, no less...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. I wonder what kind of story it'll 
develop into. I can hardly wait. I won't 
be able to take my eyes off it from now 
on.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hm! To delight the audience across a 
prolonged era, one must constantly create 
fresh stimulation... Period dramas are 
truly brimming with creative ingenuity!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes. No matter how entertaining something 
is, if there's no change, a time will 
eventually come when people get tired of 
it.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Keeping people entertained for a long, 
long time is an extraordinarily difficult 
thing...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I want to keep on running like that, too.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Just like a period drama... continuing to 
run for a long time. Steadily growing, so 
that I can bring hope to everyone.
choice_data_list:
Period dramas make a great role model, 
don't they?

Period dramas make a great role model, 
don't they?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You surely shall! That very ambition is 
the key to becoming beloved across 
generations!
